full_judgment: 13. It appears from plain reading of Annexure-1(2) and the proceeding that the order was passed by the Chairman as `Katripaksha' under Regulation 2(Gha) of Service Regulations, 1991. The act of the Chairman being an official act shall be presumed to have been regularly performed under the provisions of law unless its contrary is proved. There is nothing on record to rebut the presumption that the Chairman was duly authorized and empowered to pass the impugned order of dismissal Annexure-I(2).
